full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media image presents a single cobalt-blue fish impression on an irregular sheet of warm cream paper. The sheet floats against a plain light gray background, casting a narrow soft shadow below its lower edge. Its corners are uneven, the bottom edge dips and rises, and faint creases and brown stains remain visible through the pale surface. The fish occupies almost the full width of the paper, with its head on the left and fan-shaped tail on the right. Its round eye has a dark center ringed by blue, and its mouth opens slightly at the far left. A comb of pointed dorsal spines rises across the top of the back; softer fins spread below the belly and beside the head. Darker blue collects at the head, along the upper back, and inside the tail, while lighter broken patches reveal scales and the paper beneath. Fine fin rays, rubbing marks, and irregular pigment density make the form look pressed or transferred rather than painted as a smooth silhouette. Near the upper right are a few vertical dark blue calligraphic marks, and a smaller vertical group sits beside the head near the lower left. Their exact characters are not fully clear. Small red seal-like stamps punctuate the lower corners. The fish has no watery surroundings or ground line; it lies as a specimen-like image on the fibrous page. Diffuse light from above makes the paper warm and the blue impression matte, with only the cast shadow giving physical depth. The overall composition is spare and tactile, pairing an intricate natural form with worn paper, restrained marks, and wide cream margins.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介图像在一张不规则的暖奶油色旧纸上呈现一条钴蓝色鱼形印迹。纸张浮在素净的浅灰背景前，下缘投出一道狭窄柔和的阴影。四角不齐，下边缘起伏弯曲，浅色表面仍可见淡淡折痕与褐色斑渍。鱼几乎占满纸张的宽度，头朝左，扇形尾朝右。圆眼中央深色，外围绕蓝色环纹，最左侧的嘴微微张开。一排尖锐背鳍棘沿背部上缘升起；较柔软的鳍从腹下和头侧展开。较深的蓝色聚在头部、上背与尾鳍内部，较浅的破碎斑块则露出鳞片和下方纸色。细密鳍条、摩擦痕迹与不均匀的颜料密度让形体像被压印或转印出来，而非平滑涂出的剪影。右上附近有几笔竖向深蓝书写痕迹，鱼头旁的左下侧还有一组较小的竖向笔迹；具体字形不能完全辨认。纸张下方两角由小小的红色印章状方块点缀。鱼没有水中环境或地面线，而是作为近似标本的图像平放在纤维纸页上。上方漫射光使纸面显暖，蓝色印迹呈哑光，只有投影提供物理纵深。整体构图疏朗而可触，以繁复的自然形态搭配磨损纸面、克制笔迹和宽阔的奶油色留边。
style_prompt_en: The print-like medium combines dense blue transfer, pale exposed support, and sparse dark ink marks. Pigment settles unevenly, leaving granular speckles, rubbed gaps, and delicate linear detail within broader colored areas. A narrow range of cobalt, navy, cream, and small muted red accents carries the whole image. Edges shift between sharp impressions and incomplete, feathered contact, so the main form feels materially pressed into the page. The warm support has visible fibers, folds, staining, and irregular cut edges; it remains an active part of the composition rather than a neutral backdrop. Soft even illumination keeps the ink matte, while a shallow cast shadow distinguishes the physical sheet from its surrounding pale field. One detailed central mass is balanced by generous quiet margins and a few small peripheral marks. The effect is archival, handmade, and restrained, with texture and pigment variation supplying depth instead of modeled light.
style_prompt_zh: 这种印相般的媒介结合密实蓝色转印、露出的浅色底材与稀疏深色墨痕。颜料沉积不均，宽阔色面内部留有颗粒斑点、摩擦空隙与纤细线条。钴蓝、藏蓝、奶油色与少量暗红重音构成画面狭窄的色域。边缘在清晰压痕与不完整的羽化接触之间变化，使主要形体显得真正压入纸面。暖色底材可见纤维、折痕、污渍与不规则裁边，是构图的活跃部分，而非中性的背景。柔和均匀的照明使墨色保持哑光，一道浅薄投影则把有形纸页与周围浅色区域区分开。一个细节丰富的中央团块与宽裕安静的留边、少数边缘小标记互相平衡。整体效果有档案感、手作感与克制气息，深度由肌理及颜料变化提供，而不是由塑形光照提供。
theme_en: A cobalt fish impression on an irregular sheet of aged paper
theme_zh: 旧纸不规则纸张上的钴蓝色鱼形印迹
name: Gyotaku
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
